meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

copy.tagline: 自动化浏览器交互与网页测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码操控浏览器并验证网页行为
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and test web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically and verify web page behavior

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过命令行控制浏览器:打开网页、点击填写、抓取页面快照,还能管理标签页、Cookie 与存储、模拟网络请求、录制视频和运行调试 Playwright 测试。
howto.when: 当用户要求操作浏览器、测试网页或调试 Playwright 测试时触发;提到 “UI review”“design feedback” 等词时,还会进入页面标注评审模式。

say.text: 打开示例网站 example.com,操作完成后把页面快照发我。
say.note: Claude 会打开浏览器并返回带 ref 的页面快照。

say.text: 对这个页面做 UI 评审,打开标注模式让我圈选。
say.note: 会启动可标注界面,供你在页面上圈选和留言。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control a browser via commands: open pages, click/type, capture page snapshots, manage tabs, cookies and storage, mock network requests, record videos, and run/debug Playwright tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to drive the browser, test a web page, or debug Playwright tests; asking for “UI review”/“design feedback” starts the annotated review flow.

say_en.text: Open example.com and send me the page snapshot when done.
say_en.note: Opens the browser and replies with the snapshot.

say_en.text: Fill in this login form with test credentials, submit it, and tell me the result.
say_en.note: Uses fill, click, and snapshot commands.

say_en.text: Do a UI review of this page and start annotate mode.
say_en.note: Starts the annotatable review UI for your feedback.
